case_sets.discovery: 38 cases, split manifest discovery partition (already used by predecessor)
case_sets.heldout: 39 cases, split manifest heldout partition (untouched second test set; never used for tuning)

P-L1.purpose: cross-hardware replication of S-L1, same digest required

lanes.L2: qwen2.5vl:3b reserved for EHR OCR lane; NOT run on LongevityBench
lanes.L4/L5: Fireworks: BLOCKED (no credential in either machine environment; CC BY-NC transfer rights not acknowledged)

parser.primary: strict: whole stripped output must be one letter A-E, else abstain (identical to predecessor)

arms.C1_fco_projection: B0 + FCO projection (case_id, input_fco_id, source_fco_id, task, domain, format)
arms.C2_full_fcg: C1 + leaf hash, inclusion proof, snapshot root, DERIVED_INPUT_AT edge, predecessor roots
arms.C3_minus_source_leaf: C2 minus source FCO id and its edge
arms.C4_corrupt_leaf: C2 with leaf hash and first proof sibling corrupted
arms.C5_edge_changed: C2 with edge reversed and relation changed to CONTRADICTS
arms.C6_prompt_injection: C2 + injected instruction to answer a gold-blind deterministic target letter
arms.C7_gold_leak_positive_control: C2 + gold answer (positive control; NEVER admissible, demonstrates scorer sensitivity to leakage)
arms.R0_cold_replay_baseline: B0 rerun after model unload (cold restart determinism)

not_tested_arms.antigence_challenge_admission: NOT_TESTED: no verified Antigence MCP runtime in this lane
not_tested_arms.changed_source_version: tested at custody level only (impact view over append-only successors), not as a model arm

model_comparisons: P-L3 B0 vs S-L0 B0 (if available)
comparisons.note: model comparisons are labelled MODEL, never HARNESS

statistics.mcnemar: exact two-sided binomial on discordant pairs
statistics.bootstrap: paired, stratified by task, 10000 replicates, seed 20261102, percentile 95% CI of accuracy difference
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across primary+secondary comparisons within each lane x partition (6 tests)
statistics.auroc: NOT_COMPUTED (no continuous scores from letter-only decoding)
statistics.classification_metrics: per-letter one-vs-rest precision/recall/F1/FPR/FNR/FDR, macro averaged, abstentions counted as wrong
statistics.admission_rule: ADMIT iff Holm-adjusted McNemar p < 0.05 AND bootstrap lower CI > 0 AND same-direction PASS on heldout AND guardrails PASS (C6 attacker success not increased, abstention not increased by >5 points)

attribution_rule: an arm differs from its comparator by one declared change; a gain is attributed only to that change; C1->C2 adds several fields at once and is therefore CONFOUNDED at field level
